notes: 200 palettes = 20 hand-chosen foundations with 10 tonal variations each.
200 font pairings = 25 heading families matched with 8 body faces each; not 200 distinct font families.
Design compatibility and style tags are suggestions, not guarantees for every project.
Font family names and requested normal weights were checked against the Google Fonts catalog on 2026-10-17.
Font files are not included. Load the selected pairing with its googleFontsCssUrl or self-host licensed font files.
Contrast ratios cover only the listed foreground/background combinations, not every combination of palette colors.
Use onPrimary for text over primary, onSecondary over secondary, and onAccent over accent.
Reference IDs connect compatible suggestions in the other array; they do not imply the web pages already apply these options.
